headline: IHG Shares Slip Despite Third-Quarter RevPAR Outperforming Forecasts
summary: InterContinental Hotels Group shares fell despite the hospitality operator reporting third-quarter revenue per available room (RevPAR) that topped analyst projections.
why: IHG is one of the world's biggest hotel operators, managing brands including Holiday Inn, Crowne Plaza, and InterContinental across key global travel markets.

impacts.name: InterContinental Hotels Group
impacts.why: Shares slipped following earnings as investors looked beyond the RevPAR beat to broader leisure industry demand concerns.
